modalLead: Moving a category or widget with the keyboard works without a Home key, and Help shows how in drawings that move.

items.text: ↑ on the top row of a category goes to its title. No Home key needed: ↓ goes back to the row, and Tab on the title goes to the //, where Space picks the category up.
Space on the // no longer opens a bookmark in a new tab, and Enter on a title folds it instead of opening one.
A title and its // show focus in the colour of the selected row, instead of a ring that was cut off on two sides.
After dropping a block with the keyboard the focus stays on its //, ready for the next move.
The cursor no longer stops on hidden rows of a narrow Health widget.

Help → Structure & bookmarks → Moving categories and widgets shows the landing box, a block made wide on the column line, and a block sent to another page, in drawings that move. The dashboard tour, the tips, the cheat sheet and its PDF explain it too.
